name: Custom Book Block
description: Provides a more flexible, configurable book navigation menu block.
project_description:
A more configurable version of the navigation block provided by the Book module in core. 

 Additional options 
 
 Choose to show only a single book (or default to show all, as in core) 
 Choose to dynamically detect the current book 
 Choose a starting level and a maximum depth to create the menu 
 Force the menu to be expanded
